messages:
Priya Nadar: Hey all — final round for the SRE candidate next Wed 3pm PT. Need two interviewers + a scribe. Can someone cover the backend deep-dive?
Eleni Gomez: I can do the deep-dive but need to leave by 4:15. Is that okay?
Samir Patel: I can take system design 3:20–4:00.
Jae (Eng): I can be scribe and capture scores. I’ll upload notes to the candidate doc afterwards.
Priya Nadar: Thanks @Jae — can you use the standard debrief template? Link: https://drive.redwood/company/interviews/templates/debrief.md
People Ops Bot: Reminder: interview packet created, Zoom link set, and candidate test account provisioned (s3-temp).
Eleni Gomez: Quick rubric Q — for the reliability question do we weight identification of risks more than depth of mitigation?
Samir Patel: Prioritize risk identification + measurable mitigation. For scoring, use the 0–3 scale and call out automation or lack thereof.
Priya Nadar: Agreed. If candidate proposes a manual-only plan, mark execution concerns. Flag big unknowns in the 'notes' section so we can normalize later.
Jae (Eng): I’ll timestamp the recording and add section anchors in the doc for each interviewer.
Priya Nadar: Small debrief template (use in the doc):
```
- Strengths:
- Concerns / unknowns:
- Execution & automation:
- Recommendation (hire / no-hire / maybe):
```
Eleni Gomez: I'll add a one-line anchor to the rubric for 'automation follow-through' under Execution (1–3).
Samir Patel: LGTM :thumbsup:
Priya Nadar: Final logistics: give a 10-min buffer for overrun. If we hit overrun, ping #eng-oncall to swap an interviewer. I’ll send calendar invites and tag the hiring panel now.
Eleni Gomez: Noted, thanks — will review the candidate repo beforehand and add any specific prompts to the doc.
Jae (Eng): Got it. I’ll prep the scribe doc and checklist by EOD today.
Priya Nadar: Thanks team. See you next Wed.
